story.festival_children.name: Children's day
story.festival_children.desc: A children's-day challenge: have a feast of ten things.
story.festival_children.ch.c1.sum: Children's day is a day for treats. Eat ten things.
story.festival_children.r1.start: It's children's day! A day for playing and for treats. Eat ten things — berries, fruit, a stew — and I have something for your room.
story.festival_children.graduated: Happy children's day! Flower pots and white lamps for your room.
story.festival_children.d1.done: Ten treats! That was a proper feast.
